'''Jalis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] who was sent to investigate rumors of traitors among the guards in the [[Shadow Town]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] district on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. However, the traitors discovered and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Jalis, prompting the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] informant [[Chiiv]] to ask Imperial-aligned spacers to locate and kill the traitors.
